- [LSCO.8.7] **Sizing targets are thousands-of-facts, thousands-of-
  rules, sub-ms rule fire.** Two orders of magnitude above
  that, DS is not the right tool. The guarantees
  (determinism, testability, debuggability) depend on these
  sizing assumptions.
gap_reason: A sizing target, which is performance; conformance makes no performance claim (LCON.6.2).
